name: Jeremoth
overview: Jeremoth was a male descendant of Bani, noted specifically for having married a foreign wife. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal details recorded about him in Scripture beyond this unique attribute.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremoth appears once in Scripture without any given meaning or divine attribution. It is presented simply as a proper name in Ezra 10:29.
familyAndRelationships: Jeremoth is explicitly identified as a descendant of Bani. Beyond this connection, Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremoth's significance lies in his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, a matter addressed in Ezra 10:29. This highlights the community's concern for maintaining covenantal purity during the post-exilic period. His mention serves as a reminder of the challenges faced by God's people in upholding holiness amid cultural influences.
